detail.description: The cave-diving expedition to Rellavern is under the charge of a surveyor named Pell, who has allowed one slate for the passage and another for the finds. The flooded shrine bears carvings of Greek gods and the labours of Heracles. Pell notes them down without much comment. On the 7x7 grid, touching groups of identical symbols pay; their position in a row is of no consequence. There is a round of free spins. Sticky wilds stay put for subsequent spins, which saves at least one thing from shifting about.
